title: What a Whitepaper Is
summary: A whitepaper is the document a crypto project publishes to explain what it does, how it works, and why it exists.
blocks: A whitepaper is the document a crypto project publishes to explain what it does, how it works, and why it exists.
A clear one describes the problem, the design, the token's role, and the people involved. Vague promises and heavy hype in place of detail are a caution sign.
Reading it is one way to judge whether a project has substance, though a polished document is a starting point for questions, not proof of quality.
